newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SMH says sales driven by upper price range.
newsitem.headline: SMH says sales driven by upper price range.

text.p: Swiss watchmaker Ste Suisse Microelectronique et d'Horlogerie SA (SMH) said accelarating sales in June and July were led by its upper price segment, especially brands Omega and Rado.

"It is Omega and Rado in particular. Blancpain has also developed very well," chief financial officer Edgar Geiser told Reuters after the company released sales and operating profit for the first half of 1997.
The half-year statement said sales growth had picked up to 12 percent in June and 15 percent in July, raising hopes for the full year.
"But we have certain expectations for Swatch, we will be launching new products later this year," he added.

Geiser said the spurt in sales growth came despite a slowdown in SMH's private-label segment, brands it produces for third parties, due to a major order a year earlier that was not repeated in the first half of this year.
